title: Guide for Personal Representatives — Early Retirement of a Deceased Member's Member Equities & Patronage
content:
When an individual member dies, the estate's personal representative may ask in writing for early retirement of the member's Member Equities & Patronage equity, registered as an estate retirement request for each holding.

## Terms

- **Approval comes first.** An estate retirement may be paid only when the estate retirement request for that holding has been approved by the association after receipt of the death certificate and letters of appointment. The approval is read from the association's record of the estate retirement request on that holding.
- **What is retired.** Allocated surplus of every year is then retired at once, the Nonqualified Allocated Surplus at its stated value less the class's estate discount (the discounted amount is paid; the full stated value is retired), and borrower equity at par only when the member's loans have been repaid or assumed by another member; preferred stock is redeemed at par.
- **Payment.** Payment is made within the class's retirement processing period in calendar days of approval, by check to the estate.
- **Returned to active.** A request that is declined, or borrower equity whose loans are still open, returns the holding to active status.
- **Who has no estate retirement.** Joint and entity members have no estate retirement.

## The amount paid on an estate retirement

The amount paid is the stated value retired multiplied by one hundred less the class's estate discount percentage, divided by one hundred, rounded to cents. The discount is 6 percent on Nonqualified Allocated Surplus and 0 percent on every other class.

| Holding of a deceased individual member (hypothetical) | Retired | Paid to the estate by check |
|---|---|---|
| Nonqualified Allocated Surplus of USD 4,250.00 across several years | USD 4,250.00 | USD 3,995.00 |
| Qualified Allocated Surplus of USD 2,100.00 | USD 2,100.00 | USD 2,100.00 |
| Class B Voting Stock of USD 1,000.00, all loans repaid | USD 1,000.00 | USD 1,000.00 |
| Class B Voting Stock of USD 1,000.00, a loan still open and not assumed | Nothing; the holding returns to active | — |
| Class H Preferred Stock of USD 20,000.00 | Redeemed at par, USD 20,000.00 | USD 20,000.00 |
